overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated coriander leaves powder for B2B food manufacturing, spice blending, and private label programs. It is made from carefully selected coriander leaves and processed in controlled stages to support consistent aroma, color, and powder flow. The product is suitable for buyers who need a dry herb ingredient that is easy to handle, portion, store, and dispatch in commercial formats.

The powder is produced through sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. Standard supply is available in 60 to 100 mesh, with custom mesh sizes on request. As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India, TradeNest Naturals supports bulk supply, OEM/private label requirements, samples on request, and export documentation for agreed orders.
